exclusion_policy.task_only: Kraken/Cerberus/Smoke devil/Alchemical Hydra and other task-only or superior contexts excluded v1; no finite remaining task can guarantee an uncapped rare hunt.
exclusion_policy.task_boosted: Basilisk jaw/Drake uniques/ordinary Hydra tail task alternatives not selected; off-task reported rates outside band.
exclusion_policy.multiroll: Use dependency-free lower=max(marginal p_i), upper=min(1,sum p_i); entire range must fit band. Zulrah qualifies; King kurask same-item total needs separate review and is excluded.
exclusion_policy.group_allocation: No raids/Nex/group-personal division; solo-only authored contexts where feasible.
exclusion_policy.stateful_drops: DT2 vestiges with hidden progress/guarantees and party/contribution formulas excluded v1, not treated as geometric table fractions.
exclusion_policy.finite_keys: Bryophyta/Obor and chest/minigame/keyed reward contexts not selected.
exclusion_policy.cosmetics_and_generic: Jars, heads, pets, shared superior rare table, generic rare-table loot and repeatable shop-equipment families not selected.
exclusion_policy.additional_sources: Unlisted source/item/context is not selectable even if its numeric fraction fits. Expansion requires a new reviewed catalog version.

all_required: Correct initialized account/run identity and normal persistent game world; exclude Leagues/Deadman/beta/quest reenactments.
Own Challenge through Lesser AND Greater; own starter grant or individual target unlock.
At least three distinct unlocked accessible supported creature keys after all filtering.
Membership, authored unboosted minimum skills and completed quest/diary/stage predicates; actual required regions and entry routes legally available.
Required usable equipment and supplies are owned or legally renewable under existing access. Do not demand infinite stock, but a finite task/key-only route is not sustainable.
Source-specific repeatable route and personal solo allocation are feasible; instance fees and legal replenishment route supported.
Necessary travel/vendor/faction-KC actions are already permitted; hunt selection grants no new access or tolerance exemption.
Current validated source/loot/composition/context adapter for the live client. Unknown predicates exclude before offers.
access_contract.on_later_failure: Preserve frozen assignment/evidence/quote; show context unavailable; existing Pause/Reject only. No automatic reroll or adoption of pending retirement proposal.

event_sources: RuneLite ServerNpcLoot composition + items (candidate authoritative local loot source)
NpcLootReceived NPC + items only when ownership/source correlation is separately validated; never double-award both streams
positive_rules: Assignment was durably selected before earning encounter and loot; run/account matches.
One completed source encounter within supported location/mode/phase and solo context; frozen item/context match.
Fresh local personal assigned-source loot receipt lists exact accepted dropped item ID and quantity >=1. No pickup/turn-in/consumption prerequisite added; owning an old item is irrelevant.

Earning occurs while active; no paused-drop backfill or payout processing while paused. Ambiguous delayed earning/delivery retains evidence without automatic credit until existing timing policy can prove qualification.
Atomic once-only assignment completion/FP journal transaction; duplicate adapter streams, reconnect/replay/repeated pickup cannot pay twice.
Player keeps the drop; disposal afterward does not revoke legitimate completion. Independent first-time permanent item bounty is separately keyed and can pay once.
negative_rules: Inventory/bank increase alone, collection-log history, GE/shop/trade, teammate item, floor pickup without personal-source receipt, transformed old item, minion/other creature, quest/alternate mode or paused earning never qualify.
Unknown source/ownership/context/earning time holds evidence without inventing credit.
No proximity-only ownership; no exact string-name-only source or item mapping.
completion_contract.client_validation_status: REQUIRED_BEFORE_RUNTIME; specification complete, positive/negative current-client traces NOT_RUN.
